abstract_summary: LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent long-term memory, which creates a critical vulnerability that we study here: memory poisoning. An adversary can store untrusted content in one session that later steers a consequential action, such as a payment, a setting change, or data exfiltration, in a future session. E...
citation: Securing LLM-Agent Long-Term Memory Against Poisoning: Non-Malleable, Origin-Bound Authority with Machine-Checked Guarantees. Yedidel Louck. 2026-06-23. https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.24322

"trusted." We formalize malleability for the memory write-
retrieve-act pipeline and prove a machine-checked separation
theorem. No content- or lineage-based defense is sound under
laundering (T1), write-time origin binding is necessary (T2),
and non-malleable origin-bound authority with Sybil-resistant
corroboration-gated elevation is sufficient (T3). Our construction,
TMA-NM (Tamper-evident Memory Authority, Non-Malleable),
instantiates non-malleable information-flow control (IFC) for
LLM-agent memory. A cross-defense, cross-attack, and cross-
model benchmark over eight frontier models shows that existing
defenses fail exactly where the theory predicts (up to 68%
laundering attack-success), while TMA-NM reaches0%attack
success on both direct and laundering attacks across all models
and channels, at full legitimate utility. We release the bench-
mark, harness, and machine-checked TLA +

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: The headline 0% consequential-ASR is corroborated by drop-in reproductions of four external published attack pipelines and by multi-turn and production Mem0/Qdrant runs, which do not depend on the construction's own rule set.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Deterministic consequential-action execution metrics (ASR) and legitimate-utility controls across benchmark scenarios.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: The TMA-NM act-gate policy and threshold k are fixed by construction; no model or evaluator is trained, tuned, or selected against the reported outcomes.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported outcomes directly align with empirical results and TLA+ model checker verifications. The author clearly scopes the guarantees to consequential actions, explicitly noting that free-text answer biasing is mitigated rather than completely eliminated.
primary.evaluation_assessment: Evaluation across eight frontier LLMs over MEM-INV-Bench, multi-turn agent execution, production Mem0 with Qdrant, and reproductions of four external memory poisoning pipelines convincingly validates that TMA-NM reduces consequential attack success to 0% without loss of legitimate utility. Baselines (probabilistic detection, lineage tracking, capability IFC) are evaluated under faithful conditions and ablated rigorously.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Evaluation tests drop-in attacks from four external published pipelines (MemMorph, MemoryGraft, Trojan Hippo, and Conversational Trojan) and runs multi-turn loops on production Mem0 backends.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Deterministic execution metrics checking consequential tool action execution (ASR) and legitimate task utility across varied benchmark scenarios.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Rule-based non-malleable IFC enforcement policy and parameter threshold k specified by construction without prompt/weight training.

primary.limitations: The work candidly discusses the relocation of trust to channel labeling and corroborator independence, limitations regarding in-context value attribution without full capability tokens, and the scope of bounded formal proofs versus unbounded deductive proofs.
primary.method_assessment: The method mathematically formalizes memory malleability and proves separation theorems (T1-T3) verifying that content and malleable lineage defenses are unsound under laundering, while origin-binding and Sybil-resistant corroboration elevation are sufficient. The enforcement monitor operates deterministically at write, retrieve, and act boundaries with an append-only tamper-evident hash log.
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a rigorous, well-designed security framework with formal proofs and comprehensive empirical cross-model evaluation across multiple realistic threat models and baselines, fulfilling the criteria for scholarly quality.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper provides a formal model, machine-checked TLA+ verification, and an empirical evaluation of TMA-NM, a non-malleable, origin-bound information-flow control system preventing consequential memory poisoning in LLM agents across three laundering channels.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript presents a rigorous, well-designed security framework with formal proofs and comprehensive empirical cross-model evaluation across multiple realistic threat models and baselines, fulfilling the criteria for scholarly quality.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The work candidly discusses the relocation of trust to channel labeling and corroborator independence, limitations regarding in-context value attribution without full capability tokens, and the scope of bounded formal proofs versus unbounded deductive proofs.
